messages:
erin: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. Need firm owners, backups, and short timelines for the missing-spans, aggregation drift, and ETL lag items. I'll seed a compact plan; edit inline.

rachel: Thx. I can own aggregator dedupe + reconciliation. Root cause recap: retried batch replays + window misalign.

tom: I'll take the span extractor backpressure. Short mitigation = JVM GC tuning + +consumer threads; full fix = tokenized backpressure + chunk acks.

priya: ETL lag was an incorrect partition rebalance + broker stall. Reverted the rollout; adding `etl.lag_95` alert and emergency partition-reassign runbook.

erin: Proposed owners/timelines:
- A: span extractor mitigation -> tom -> staging tweak today, canary 24h, full redesign by 2026-04-14
- B: aggregator idempotency + reconciliation -> rachel -> PR in 4d, canary 1w, reconciliation job 3w
- C: ETL partition stability -> priya -> alerts+runbook today, full tuning 48h

jordan: I'll be backup for Tom during on-call next week. Also suggest a short CI chaos test that simulates short GC pauses.

tom: Deploying JVM tweak to staging now (pin GC flags + bump heap). Watching `span.kv.misses` and `gc.pause_ms`.

ops-bot: deploy started by tom at 1856123502 — span-extractor/jvm-tweak -> staging

rachel: Dedupe plan: key by (trace_id, span_id, batch_id) with small sliding cache + metric `agg.dedupe.hits`. Reconciliation will be opt-in and run against internal aggregates first.

priya: Runbook added: emergency partition reassign steps + safe broker check. Also instrumented `etl.partition.idle_seconds` dashboard tile.

erin: Two systemic items: 1) add GC-pause regression to chaos-suite -> owner: rachel -> ETA 2w, 2) weekly correctness digest tile (metrics: `agg.dedupe.hits`, `span.kv.misses`, `etl.lag_95`) -> owner: erin -> ETA 1w.

jordan: Customer comms? Support asked for a blurb. Draft: "We've identified and mitigigated the causes of recent span loss and aggregation mismatches. Engineers have rolled mitigations and are deploying fixes; dashboards should normalize within 48 hours."

priya: Fine to send once staging canary looks green.

erin: Locking owners in the doc now and scheduling 09:15 daily 15m check-ins for 3 days to validate telemetry. If blocked, DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
